changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: IF USER_ID('reporting_reader') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (select 1 from information_schema.routines where routine_schema = 'reporting' and routine_type = 'function' and routine_name = 'StripHTML') BEGIN grant execute on reporting.StripHTML to reporting_reader; END
changeSet.rollback: IF USER_ID('reporting_reader') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (select 1 from information_schema.routines where routine_schema = 'reporting' and routine_type = 'function' and routine_name = 'StripHTML') BEGIN revoke execute on reporting.StripHTML to reporting_reader; END
